artifact: registered SPARC x Cassini tanh-log joint execution

profile_data.selection: eVobs/Vobs <= 0.10; positive R, Vobs, and Vbar^2

benchmark.benchmark: RAR q values from Desmond, Hees & Famaey (2024)

instrument_validation.convergence_rule: two consecutive radial changes below 0.5%, followed by angular 128-to-256 change below 0.5%
instrument_validation.short_circuit_rule: Cassini is not evaluated where SPARC delta_BIC exceeds 14 under all three recorded conventions; such a point cannot belong to any primary or mandatory-sensitivity intersection

primary_definition.cassini: signed Q2 inside the current two-sided 95% interval at g_ext=2.32e-10 m s^-2
primary_definition.ambiguity_guard: also report fixed-gamma-vs-McGaugh and family-k2-vs-McGaugh BIC conventions; the verdict may not depend on choosing among them

verdict: The registered scale-universal tanh-log family is incompatible with the joint SPARC and Cassini constraints as a QUMOND interpolation family at the registered resolution.
scope_caveat: This closes only the scale-universal QUMOND realization. It does not test modified inertia, engineering-only companders, multi-scale or system-dependent theories, dark/hybrid models, or the Synchronism umbrella ontology.
aqual_sensitivity: Not independently computed. Literature transfer says AQUAL is typically at least as constrained for the benchmark families; no AQUAL-specific verdict is claimed.
